statement: Every tetrahedral geometric closure and every intermediate has both all-prime cusp assertions
notes: Registered after complete root and DE independent proof/source/executed-certificate audits PASS. Every A4 closure is identified with an actual V4 Kummer cover of a degree3 elliptic isogeny using the split F2[C3] puncture sequence. Exact isogeny and complementary elliptic maps give j(F)=4608±2688sqrt3 and good two-rank-zero Jacobians. At3 the actual tame V4 normalization has a rational six-cusp centre and four supersingular elliptic tails. The explicit residual centre and characteristic-polynomial residue argument prove the wild C3 quotient has two elliptic components and a rational two-cusp centre, without assuming quotient formation commutes with reduction. A42 gives all fixed groups, A46 handles normalizers at2/3, and A57 plus prime-to-prime good curve models handles the others. The universal Task A.5 remains Open.
